Pueblo Nuevo — Madrid, Spain

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Pueblo Nuevo is the most heavily documented barrio in this district for violent crime. In January 2024 a group of youths stabbed a 14-year-old at Pueblo Nuevo metro station; in May 2024 a young man was robbed and thrown onto the tracks at the same station. A nearby park is repeatedly named as a contested turf zone between two gangs, with further stabbings, a mass brawl with 14 arrests, and 8 further arrests including a gang leader across 2024. Sources checked: Telecinco, 18 Jan 2024; El Espanol, 27 May 2024; El Espanol, 29 Oct 2024; El Debate, 1 Mar 2024.

Is Pueblo Nuevo safe?

Wandroz currently rates Pueblo Nuevo in Madrid, Spain as roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered at night.
